name: cull_and_normalize_face_vertices
description: Compares cross-product magnitudes against a threshold and returns early when they exceed it. For visible faces it scales three coordinate sets by one shared shift, transforms them through a 3x3 matrix, and stores the results before calling further routines.

name: select_closest_visible_face
description: Scales three coordinate sets by a shift derived from their largest magnitude and rejects faces using cross-product comparisons. It follows a chain of offset links to a depth value and keeps the face data only when that depth is smaller than the stored best value.

name: store_nearest_face_depth
description: Looks up a per-object offset in a table, applies a shared scale shift to three coordinates, and transforms them through a 3x3 matrix. It follows an offset chain to a depth value and writes the record only when that depth is smaller than the current best.

name: transform_vector_pair_and_record
description: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix by one input vector and by a second vector read from memory, storing six results in an output buffer. It then follows an offset chain to a depth value and writes the record when that depth is smaller than the current best.

name: interpret_command_byte_stream
description: Reads a zero-terminated byte stream of commands, each optionally gated by a bit test on a table value. Each command loads a vertex from an offset table, applies sign flips selected by flag bits, and dispatches to routines keyed by command words until the stream ends.

name: walk_command_stream_entries
description: Checks the high bit of the first command byte and then walks a byte stream of commands gated by flag-bit tests. For each command it applies sign flips to a vertex and dispatches to handlers keyed by command words.

name: test_flag_then_run_commands
description: Checks one bit of a mask against a selector before entering a loop over a command byte stream. The loop applies vertex transforms and sign flips for each command and dispatches to handlers keyed by command words.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work.

name: run_masked_command_stream
description: Calls a helper and compares two of its results, then walks a byte command stream that tests flag bits, applies sign flips to transformed vertices and dispatches on command words. It ends when a zero command byte is read.

name: dispatch_stream_commands_with_mask
description: Calls a helper and compares its results with stored bounds, then reads a byte command stream in which flag-bit tests decide which commands run. Each command is either a vertex transform or a dispatch to a handler, and the loop ends at a zero byte.

name: process_offset_vertex_command
description: Looks up a vertex from an offset table, applies a scaled offset and sign flips chosen by flag bits, and calls a helper with the result. It then dispatches command words in a loop and continues reading the byte stream until a zero byte.

name: call_single_helper_unknown
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this 13-instruction routine, so its body cannot be recovered from the evidence. The listing shows one caller and one call to another routine.

name: call_four_helpers_unknown
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this 41-instruction routine, so its body cannot be recovered from the evidence. The listing shows two callers and four calls to other routines.

name: call_three_helpers_brief
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this 6-instruction routine, so its body cannot be recovered from the evidence. The listing shows one caller and three calls to other routines.

name: call_three_helpers_seven
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this 7-instruction routine, so its body cannot be recovered from the evidence. The listing shows one caller and three calls to other routines.

name: match_string_entries_in_range
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string and calls a helper for each entry to get a value. When the value falls within the two bounds, it copies three words into a fixed record, and it returns zero at the terminator.

name: store_string_entries_in_bounds
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string, calling a helper per entry and comparing the result with bounds held in registers. When the result is in range, it copies three words into a fixed record and stops at the terminator.

name: scan_string_entries_for_bounds
description: Scans a zero-terminated byte string, calling a helper per entry and testing the result against two register bounds. Matching entries have three words copied into a fixed record before the loop ends at the terminator.

name: record_string_values_within_limits
description: Loops over a zero-terminated byte string, calling a helper for each entry and checking the value against limits. Values inside the limits are copied as three words into a fixed record, and the loop returns at the terminator.

name: project_point_by_division
description: Computes a dot product of a point's offset from a stored origin with a table entry, then divides it by a second dot product built from stored weights. It returns the quotient in the low half and the remainder in the high half, or a saturated value when the divisor is zero.

name: project_indexed_point_division
description: Loads a point from a base pointer plus an offset, takes its offset from a stored origin, and dots it with a stored row. It divides that by a second dot product built from stored weights, returning the quotient and remainder packed together, or a saturated value when the divisor is zero.

name: project_register_point_division
description: Optionally shifts three register coordinates left by a count, then takes their offsets from a stored origin and dots them with register weights. It divides that by a second dot product built from stored weights, returning a packed quotient and remainder, or a saturated value when the divisor is zero.

name: xor_upper_word_with_register
description: XORs a 16-bit register value with the upper word of a 32-bit input and returns the result, combined with a sign-derived mask. The pseudo-code shows only this XOR and a constant mask of 32767, so no further purpose is inferred.

name: divide_projection_shift_subtract
description: Saves six input values to a record and computes a sum of products with a vector from memory, rejecting the result when bound tests fail. The remaining code is a shift-and-subtract division loop that produces a normalized quotient; the listing is truncated before its final stores.

name: divide_normalized_projection_quotient
description: Computes a sum of products with a vector from memory and bounds-checks it. It then performs a shift-and-subtract division to a normalized quotient and compares that against stored bounds before writing fields into the record.

name: record_signed_projection_quotient
description: Negates input components according to their sign bits, forms a sum of products with a vector from memory, and rejects results that fail bound tests. It computes a normalized quotient by shift-and-subtract division and writes the result, its exponent and a copy of the input block into the record when it is smaller than the stored value.

name: store_projection_if_smaller
description: Scales an input value by a stored shift and compares the result against a stored bound. When it is smaller, it saves the result, an exponent and a copy of five stored words into the record and sets a flag byte.

name: store_shifted_value_if_below
description: Shifts an input by a stored count and, when the result is below the stored bound, writes it with a normalized exponent and a copy of five words into the record. It also sets a flag byte to non-zero.

name: store_projection_record_unconditionally
description: Writes two input words and a normalized quotient into the record, copies five stored words into its second block and sets a flag byte. It does this without comparing against the stored bound.

name: copy_block_from_pointer
description: Waits until a flag word in the record is zero, then copies eight 32-bit values from the source pointer into a fixed record block and copies one more word from it. It then clears a status byte.

name: copy_global_block_and_flag
description: Calls a helper, then copies eight 32-bit values from fixed global locations into the record, along with a global word and a second word set to 52. It sets the status byte to non-zero.

name: copy_global_block_to_record
description: Copies eight 32-bit values from fixed global locations into the record, sets a word to a global value and a second word to 52. It then sets a status byte to non-zero.

name: wait_for_flags_clear
description: Spins in two loops, one until a record flag word is zero and one until a global word is zero, then returns.

name: copy_ten_value_records_block
description: Copies 800 blocks of ten 32-bit values from one global pointer to another, advancing both pointers by one block per pass. It then returns the input register values unchanged.

name: copy_strided_table_blocks
description: Copies 31 passes of data between two global buffers, starting at a fixed table offset. Each pass moves ten 32-bit values and three nine-value blocks at fixed offsets of 2001, 4001 and 6001 values.

name: store_eight_register_values
description: Stores eight input registers into consecutive 32-bit slots of the record and sets a flag byte to non-zero.

name: reset_and_wait_for_flags
description: Clears a flag byte, waits until a record flag word is zero, writes the constant 12820 into a word and clears another byte. It calls a helper and then waits for the flag word to clear again.

name: store_word_in_two_slots
description: Stores one 16-bit input value into two fixed word slots in the record.

name: swap_buffer_pointers
description: Copies eight 32-bit values from one record block to another, then swaps two global buffer pointers and toggles a global flag byte. The facts list the copper list pointer register as touched, but the pseudo-code does not show that write.

name: copy_buffer_pointer_global
description: Copies one global buffer pointer into another global pointer slot.

name: copy_second_buffer_pointer
description: Copies the second global buffer pointer into a third global pointer slot.

name: infinite_loop_halt
description: Contains an unconditional infinite loop with no data operations or hardware access, so the routine never returns.

name: wait_and_set_flag_one
description: Spins while a global counter is positive, then sets that counter to one.

name: wait_and_set_flag_two
description: Spins while a global counter is positive, then sets that counter to two.

name: read_queued_byte_entry
description: Reads and clears a pending byte in the record. A negative byte is returned together with a second stored byte, while a positive byte selects a table entry using two flag bytes.

name: take_pending_byte_value
description: Clears a pending flag byte in the record and returns the stored byte that follows it.

name: store_byte_and_set_pending
description: Stores the low byte of the input into a record slot and sets the pending flag byte to 255.

name: take_pending_byte_or_lookup
description: Checks a counter byte in the record: a negative value returns the stored byte, zero returns zero, and a positive value clears the pending flag and returns a table entry chosen by the counter and two flag bytes.

name: clear_counter_byte
description: Clears a counter byte in the record.

name: setup_graphics_interrupts
description: Clears a block of record memory, then opens graphics.library and sets an interrupt server through exec library calls. It writes display, bitplane, DMA and interrupt-enable hardware registers and three color registers.

name: open_dos_library_handle
description: Opens dos.library through an exec library vector call and stores the returned library pointer in a record slot.

name: wait_and_call_handlers
description: Waits until a record flag word is zero, writes a value to the interrupt-control register and calls a library vector. It then calls a second routine through a pointer stored in the record.

name: invoke_interrupt_handler
description: Calls a handler through a pointer stored in the record, then writes an interrupt-enable value with the set bit and calls a library vector.

name: shutdown_interrupt_and_dma_state
description: Saves a global value, writes DMA and interrupt-control register values, and calls library routines to remove an interrupt server and set an interrupt vector. The facts also list copper pointer registers as touched.

name: copy_color_block_on_raster
description: Writes a global value and, when a flag is set, waits for the vertical beam position to pass a threshold. It then copies eight words into the color registers starting at COLOR00 and writes an interrupt-enable value.

name: process_input_and_update_state
description: Clears a pending flag and copies global values into a state variable, then calls helpers twice and updates counters and timers. It copies eight words into the color registers and conditionally calls routines based on flag bytes. The facts also list joystick, button, port and blitter registers as touched.

name: advance_blit_countdown_step
description: Decrements a countdown word and, while it stays non-zero, selects one of two values from a flag bit, shifts a flag word and adds 8000 to an accumulator. When the countdown reaches zero it clears a byte instead; the facts list blitter control and interrupt registers as touched.

name: advance_blit_accumulator_step
description: Writes a fixed register value, halves a record word and adds 8000 to an accumulator stored in the record. It then writes the record word and an interrupt-enable value; the facts list blitter control, destination and size registers as touched.

name: clear_flag_and_enable_interrupts
description: Clears a record flag word and writes an interrupt-enable value with the set bit.

name: open_input_device
description: Calls two helpers to create a message port and request block, then calls the exec OpenDevice vector for input.device. If the open succeeds, it sets the request fields and calls the exec DoIO vector.

name: close_input_device
description: When the input request is open, it calls the exec DoIO and CloseDevice vectors on that request. It then calls cleanup helpers, including one that clears object flags and one that releases the message port.

name: update_button_state_entry
description: Handles a state entry whose type byte is one by recording a bit from a flag byte into a global table slot and updating the stored last value. Entries of type two are ignored and other types return immediately.

name: clear_entry_fields
description: Clears three byte fields and one word field in a structure addressed by the address register, then returns zero.

name: allocate_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a memory block for a message port, then sets its type, signal and task fields. It initialises an empty list header when no list is supplied, otherwise it adds the port to that list, and it frees the signal if memory allocation fails.

name: free_message_port
description: For a non-null port, it removes the port with RemPort when its list field is set, marks two bytes as 255, then calls FreeSignal and FreeMem.

name: set_record_word_pair_defaults
description: Sets two 16-bit record fields to zero and 512.

name: store_word_pair_in_record
description: Stores two 16-bit input values into record fields at fixed offsets.

name: read_word_pair_from_record
description: Combines two 16-bit record fields into a 32-bit result, with the first field in the upper half and the second in the lower half.

name: read_low_two_bits_flag
description: Returns the low two bits of a flag byte stored in the record.

name: update_cursor_position
description: Adds the stored input offsets to a cursor position and clamps it to a 320 by 200 area. It writes a derived position value to a fixed location and tests the position against a table of rectangles, setting a state byte and flags when a region matches.

name: process_joystick_input
description: Decays two velocity words toward zero by 300 per update, then adds or subtracts 700 for each active direction, saturating at the 16-bit signed limits. It stores the velocities and a status word back to the state, and the facts list the joystick port and fire-button registers as read.

name: set_record_word_minus_one
description: Sets a 16-bit record field to all ones, which is minus one.

name: append_global_record_table
description: Sets a record word to minus one, finds the end of a record list by stepping over five-word entries, then copies records from a global table into it. Each copied record is followed by a minus-one marker, and copying stops at a negative terminator.

name: append_input_records_to_list
description: Finds the end of a record list in the record and copies five-word records from the source pointer into it. Each copied record is followed by a minus-one marker, and copying stops after a negative terminator.

name: remove_matching_list_entry
description: Searches a list of word records for one whose ninth word equals the input value, then shifts the following records back by five words over it. The negative terminator is kept at the end of the list.

name: append_clamped_range_entry
description: Finds the end of a list and appends an entry that stores two low values, each the input minus an offset floored at zero. It also stores sums of the inputs with the offset and a minus-one terminator.

name: append_asymmetric_range_entry
description: Finds the end of a list and appends an entry whose two low values are each an input minus its own offset, floored at zero. It stores the offset sums, a fixed value and a minus-one terminator.

name: initialize_coordinate_table
description: Writes four 32-bit values derived from the input, each 8000 more than the last, split into high and low words. It then fills a series of 16-bit entries with the constants 1756, 256, 1812 and 256, and returns the address of the global block.

name: run_timed_main_loop
description: Initialises a set of state fields, then loops forever. Each pass advances a 64-bit timer, runs a sequence of helper and library calls, and checks the timer value against a modulus of seven before running periodic helpers.

name: run_timed_countdown_sequence
description: Initialises several state fields and calls library and helper routines. It copies a zero-terminated string from a fixed source into a buffer, then runs a countdown that clamps its value to at least 35000 and repeats while the value stays above minus 700000, waiting on a flag on each pass.

name: poll_input_timed_loop
description: Calls a helper to initialise state, then loops while advancing a timer on each pass. Polled input codes are tested against one fixed code and a small range; matching codes run cleanup and library calls before the routine returns or continues.

name: initialize_and_run_main_loop
description: Clears buffer pointers and calls a series of helpers to set up state, then enters an endless loop. Each pass advances a 64-bit timer and polls input, and one specific input code runs a fixed sequence of library calls before returning.

name: resume_timed_input_loop
description: Continues a timed loop that advances a 64-bit timer and polls input, returning when a fixed input code is seen. The listing shows the loop body and the exit sequence, which was entered from a gap the disassembler decoded as code.

name: run_loop_then_restore_display
description: Runs the timed polling loop and, on exit, closes and reopens libraries, releases the blitter and remakes the display. It also points the copper list at a new address; the listing is truncated, so the full cleanup order is not visible.

name: format_signed_integer_decimal
description: Writes a signed 32-bit value as a decimal string, prefixing a minus sign for negative values. It repeatedly subtracts powers of ten from 1000000000 down to 1, writes each digit, and ends the string with a zero terminator.

name: convert_unsigned_to_ten_digits
description: Converts an unsigned 32-bit integer into ten decimal characters by repeated subtraction of powers of ten, then writes a zero terminator. The last character is formed by adding a colon code to the remainder, so it is not a plain digit.

name: render_text_with_control_codes
description: Stores a position and a parameter in the record, then walks a zero-terminated text buffer. Printable characters are drawn while the horizontal position is below 316, and control codes move the position, change the state word or change a pointer.

name: format_eight_digit_hex_string
description: Writes a 32-bit value as eight hexadecimal digit characters by rotating out one nibble at a time, using letters for values above nine. It then adds a zero terminator.

name: read_line_with_limit
description: Measures a starting string, then reads characters into a buffer with a maximum length. Backspace and delete remove the last character, printable characters such as letters, digits, space, underscore, hyphen and parentheses are appended while there is room, and carriage return ends the input.

name: edit_text_buffer_line
description: Edits a line buffer by reading characters through a helper. Backspace removes a character, carriage return ends editing, and printable characters such as letters, digits, space, underscore, hyphen and parentheses are appended while the count allows.

name: forward_to_text_helper
description: Calls one text helper routine and returns; the pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: parse_signed_decimal_integer
description: Parses a decimal integer from a character string and negates the result when a minus sign leads. Digits are accumulated until the first non-digit character is reached.

name: skip_decimal_digit_run
description: Advances a string pointer over a run of decimal digit characters. It returns early when the current character is below the digit range.

name: forward_to_single_helper
description: Calls one helper routine and returns; the pseudo-code shows no other work, although the facts list a larger instruction count.

name: compute_cross_product
description: Stores three input components in a vector structure, then writes the three cross-product components of that vector with a stored second vector. Some decompiled products appear to cancel to zero, so those terms are not interpreted.

name: return_constant_two
description: Returns the constant 2 and does nothing else.

name: return_constant_three
description: Returns the constant 3 and does nothing else.

name: return_constant_four
description: Returns the constant 4 and does nothing else.

name: return_constant_five
description: Returns the constant 5 and does nothing else.

name: classify_value_into_band
description: Compares a 16-bit input against descending threshold values and returns a band number paired with a boundary value. Inputs above the top threshold map to band two, and smaller inputs fall through to further bands.

name: integrate_and_damp_velocity_axes
description: Adds scaled velocity terms to three position fields when a flag is set, clamping the input value first. For each axis whose magnitude exceeds 14 it adds a scaled offset, damps a 3x3 table by shifts and decrements a countdown byte that resets to 60 on underflow.

name: damp_axis_pair_with_offset
description: Handles two axis values of a record, passed with a limit on the stack. When an axis magnitude exceeds 14 it adds a scaled offset, damps the matrix entries by shifts and decrements a countdown byte that resets to 60 on underflow.

name: damp_three_axes_register_limit
description: Clamps a first axis value to a limit held in registers, then runs the same damping step on three axes: when a magnitude exceeds 14 it adds a scaled offset, damps the matrix entries and decrements a countdown byte that resets to 60 on underflow.

name: damp_two_axes_with_limit
description: Applies the damping step to two axis values of a record using a limit passed on the stack. Each axis above a magnitude of 14 gets a scaled offset, shift-based damping of its matrix entries and a countdown byte that resets to 60 on underflow.

name: damp_last_axis_stacked_limit
description: Applies the damping step to the last axis of a record using a limit passed on the stack. When its magnitude exceeds 14 it adds a scaled offset, damps the matrix entries and decrements a countdown byte that resets to 60 on underflow.

name: damp_two_axes_register_limit
description: Applies the damping step to two axis values of a record, using limits from input registers. Each axis above a magnitude of 14 gets a scaled offset, shift-based damping of its matrix entries and a countdown byte that resets to 60 on underflow.

name: damp_last_axis_record_limit
description: Applies the damping step to the last axis of a record using a limit passed on the stack, reading the record through a pointer. When the magnitude exceeds 14 it adds a scaled offset, damps the matrix entries and decrements a countdown byte that resets to 60 on underflow.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work.

name: damp_last_axis_register_limit
description: Applies the damping step to the last axis of a record using a limit from input registers. When the magnitude exceeds 14 it adds a scaled offset, damps the matrix entries and decrements a countdown byte that resets to 60 on underflow.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work.

name: shift_and_negate_record_fields
description: Stores one record word shifted right by three into another field, and stores the negation of a second word shifted right by two into a third field.

name: compute_projected_components_clamped
description: Computes two dot products of a stored vector with rows of a matrix and negates the first result, zeroing a third field. When a third dot product is negative, it replaces the two results with plus or minus 16384, following the sign of each result.

name: compute_dot_products_xor_masked
description: Computes two dot products into record fields and zeroes a third field. When the third dot product is non-negative, it XORs the shifted high bytes of the first two results with 16383.

name: compute_negated_global_dot
description: Computes a dot product of a record's vector with three words from a global block, then negates and scales it into a record field.

name: compute_pairwise_dot_products
description: Compares type bytes of two records. When they match and a flag byte is set, it stores halved components; when the types match without the flag, it stores a negated dot product of the two records' vectors, and it returns early when the types differ.

name: compute_pairwise_dot_or_halves
description: When a flag byte in the record is clear, it stores a negated dot product of two records' vectors, with a second pair written only when a register flag is set. When the flag byte is set, it stores halved components of the record's own vector.

name: compute_pairwise_dot_fields
description: Computes a negated dot product of two records' vectors and stores it in one field. When a register flag is non-zero it also stores two more dot products into the other fields, each scaled by a shift.

name: normalize_pair_to_14_bits
description: Calls two helpers for a pair of 32-bit values, then combines the sign-adjusted magnitudes of the inputs. It shifts the values right until they fit in a 14-bit range, using a bitwise shift loop for the remaining bits, and returns both shifted values.

name: normalize_register_pair
description: Combines the sign-adjusted magnitudes of register inputs, then shifts the two register values right by a count derived from that magnitude so they fit in 14 bits. A bitwise shift loop handles the case where a second combined value is non-zero, and both shifted values are returned.

name: shift_pair_below_bound
description: Counts how many right shifts reduce a value to 16383 or less, then shifts two input values right by that count and returns them.

name: invoke_two_handlers
description: Calls one routine twice in succession and returns, with no other work.

name: transform_or_normalize_vector_pair
description: When the first record's flag byte is set and the second's is clear, it computes two dot products with a matrix and scales them by a left and a right shift. Otherwise it combines the sign-adjusted magnitudes of its inputs and shifts the values to fit in 14 bits.

name: apply_scaled_record_offset
description: Calls a helper for a 64-bit value and adds two record offsets to its high and low halves. Each offset is a 16-bit record field moved into the upper bits and scaled down by six bits before the addition.

name: subtract_or_negate_offsets
description: When a type byte in the record differs from a second record's byte and matches its other type byte, it calls a helper and subtracts two stored record values from the helper's halves. Otherwise it returns the two stored values negated.

name: negate_pair_of_ints
description: Reads two 32-bit record fields, negates each one and returns them together as a 64-bit pair.

name: step_position_delta_when_enabled
description: When a flag bit in the record is clear, it calls a helper and a function-pointer routine, then returns the negated changes of two position fields shifted right by ten bits. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: step_position_delta_scaled
description: Returns the stored 64-bit offset unless a mode byte equals one. In that case, when a flag bit is clear, it calls a helper and a function-pointer routine, then returns the negated position changes shifted right by ten bits, and returns zero when the flag is set.

name: update_scaled_motion_record
description: Normalizes a pair of 64-bit values by shifts into a 14-bit range and stores their components in record fields. It decrements a countdown byte and, on underflow, recomputes scaled components from global values; a threshold test then copies or accumulates position fields.

name: update_scaled_motion_record_registers
description: Takes its inputs from registers instead of memory, shifting them into a 14-bit range and storing the components in record fields. A countdown byte triggers recomputation of scaled values on underflow, and a threshold test can add position changes and clear several record fields.

name: update_motion_record_stacked_inputs
description: Updates a motion record from values passed on the stack and in registers. It normalizes and stores components, optionally recomputes countdown-driven scaled values, and when a threshold test passes it accumulates position and velocity fields and clears several record fields.

name: normalize_and_store_motion_components
description: Normalizes three register-supplied components by shifts into a 14-bit range and stores them in the record. A threshold test then decides whether scaled position fields are accumulated and a block of record fields is cleared.

name: accumulate_motion_with_threshold
description: Normalizes register inputs to a 14-bit range and stores them in the record. When a threshold test passes it adds scaled values into 64-bit accumulators and clears several record fields; the listing is truncated before its end.

name: add_shifted_offsets_to_record
description: Shifts three register offsets right by a count and adds them to three register inputs, storing the sums in record fields. It then calls a helper and returns its 64-bit result shifted left or right by a clamped count.

name: shift_register_pair_right
description: Shifts two 32-bit register inputs right by a variable count and returns both results as a 64-bit pair.

name: delegate_single_call_unknown
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available for this two-instruction routine. The listing shows one caller and one call to another routine.

name: accumulate_motion_when_moving
description: When any of three record fields is non-zero, it calls helpers, adds the returned values into three 64-bit accumulators and clears several record fields, then returns zero. Otherwise it normalizes stored components and returns a shifted 64-bit value.

name: accumulate_and_reset_motion_state
description: When a flag bit in the second record is set, it copies a byte from that record into the first. It then calls helpers, adds the returned values to three 64-bit accumulators and clears several record fields.

name: store_offsets_minus_scaled_products
description: Computes three products of register inputs with a sign-adjusted scale and subtracts them from negated record offsets, storing the results in record fields. It then calls a helper and returns its 64-bit result shifted by a clamped count.

name: store_scaled_vector_differences
description: Multiplies the record's three vector components by a scaled input, applying sign handling, and stores each product minus a stored offset into record fields. It then calls a helper and returns its 64-bit result shifted by a clamped count.

name: multiply_matrix_by_scaled_vector
description: Shifts three register values right until each fits in a 14-bit range, then multiplies a record's 3x3 matrix by the shifted vector. It returns two of the resulting components, taken from the high halves of their products.

name: multiply_vector_by_matrix
description: Multiplies three input words by rows of a 3x3 matrix in memory and returns two of the results, each taken from the high half of a doubled sum.

name: clamp_three_to_record_limits
description: Clamps three register values using one limit from the record for negative inputs and another for positive inputs. The clamped values are stored in three record fields.

name: clamp_values_with_minimum
description: Raises the first value to at least a register minimum, clamps the second and third values to record limits by sign, and stores all three in record fields.

name: clamp_pair_store_first_word
description: Stores a word input in the first record field, then clamps two register values to record limits by sign and stores them in the next two fields.

name: clamp_second_value_with_minimum
description: Raises the second value to at least a register minimum, clamps the third value to record limits, and stores three values in the record.

name: clamp_last_value_to_limits
description: Clamps the third input to record limits and stores the first two inputs together with the clamped third value in record fields.

name: raise_last_value_to_minimum
description: Raises the third input to at least a register minimum and stores the three inputs in record fields.

name: store_three_words_in_record
description: Stores three 16-bit inputs into consecutive record fields without any clamping.

name: accumulate_weighted_matrix_product
description: Normalizes an input by a shift count, multiplies a record's 3x3 matrix by the scaled vector using three weights, and adds doubled sums to 32-bit accumulators. A non-negative shift count adds shifted results directly, while otherwise the low and high halves are added with carry.

name: accumulate_weighted_matrix_saturating
description: Normalizes an input and forms weighted matrix products like its neighbour, but saturates each sum at the sign limits. It stops without updating when an addition would overflow.

name: clamp_and_accumulate_offsets
description: Clamps register values to limits, adds one into a 16-bit record field and the others into 32-bit offsets, and checks each addition for overflow. It returns early without storing when an overflow would occur.

name: accumulate_clamped_offsets_pair
description: Adds a register word into one 16-bit record field, then clamps two values and stores one unchanged and two as sums with overflow checks. It returns early when a check fails.

name: clamp_and_add_value
description: Raises an input to at least a limit and adds a second value to it, with an overflow check. The result is stored with two other values in record fields.

name: clamp_shifted_vector_and_accumulate
description: Shifts three register values right by a count, clamps each against bounds stored in the record and adds the results to three 32-bit offsets. The update is skipped if any addition would overflow.

name: clamp_and_accumulate_three_offsets
description: Clamps three register values to limits passed in registers and adds them to three record offsets. Nothing is stored if any addition would overflow.

name: accumulate_with_clamped_pair
description: Adds an unclamped register value into a record offset and adds two clamped register values into the other offsets. The update is skipped if any addition would overflow.

name: accumulate_offsets_with_minimum_pair
description: Adds a register value unchanged into one record offset and adds two register values, each raised to its bound when below it, into the other offsets. The update is skipped when any addition would overflow.

name: accumulate_two_offsets_and_clamp
description: Adds two register values unchanged into two record offsets and adds a clamped third value into the last offset. The update is skipped on overflow.

name: accumulate_pair_with_clamped_third
description: Adds two register values unchanged into two record offsets and adds a third value, clamped to a register limit, into the last offset. The update is skipped when an addition would overflow.

name: accumulate_three_offsets_checked
description: Adds three register values into three 32-bit record offsets, storing nothing when any addition would overflow.

name: apply_normalized_motion_correction
description: When a flag byte is set, it normalizes the record's three 64-bit motion accumulators by a shift count and divides a fixed-point term to get a scale. It adds the scaled components to velocity fields and offsets with carries and returns the scalar, or zero when the flag is clear.

name: apply_scaled_correction_registers
description: Scales three register components by a shift count, computes a fixed-point quotient correction when a flag word in the record is set, and adds the results into velocity fields and offsets with carries. Its sign handling and early return follow the pattern of its neighbour.

name: scale_and_add_three_offsets
description: Scales three register components by a multiplier, then either adds them directly into 32-bit offsets or shifts them and also accumulates 16-bit velocity fields with carry, depending on the sign of a shift count.

name: shift_and_accumulate_offsets
description: Shifts three input values right by a count plus sixteen when that count is non-negative, then adds them into three 32-bit record offsets.

name: add_motion_state_from_other
description: Copies a flag byte from a second record and adds its 96-bit motion accumulators into the first record's accumulators with carries. It then calls helpers and adds their returned values to the first record's offsets.

name: subtract_entity_position
description: Copies a flag byte into the record, then subtracts a second record's motion accumulators from the first's with borrows. It also subtracts a helper's result and a stored offset from the record's offsets.

name: select_nearest_matching_entry
description: Scans a table of entries from the highest index downward, testing a bit in each one. For matching entries it computes a scaled distance from a stored value, keeps the smallest, then copies that entry's flag and position differences into the record.

name: select_weighted_table_entry
description: Returns early when a record flag byte is set. Otherwise it scans a table of entries for the best weighted match, ranking candidates with flags and stored values, then updates the record's flag and offset values from the chosen entry.

name: scan_table_for_matching_flag
description: Scans a table of entries for one whose flag matches a register value, computing a weighted cost for each candidate and keeping the smallest. It then updates the record's flag and offsets from the chosen entry.

name: add_motion_state_copy_flag
description: Copies a flag byte from a second record, adds its 96-bit motion accumulators into the first and adds a helper's returned value into the offsets.

name: copy_flag_and_add_motion
description: Calls a helper, copies a flag byte from a second record, adds that record's motion accumulators into the first, and adds a helper's 64-bit result into the offsets.

name: clear_flag_and_scan_table
description: Clears the bit of value two in a status byte and, when that bit was previously clear, scans a table backward for entries with the bit of value 64 set. For each match it calls a helper and writes zero to a byte and a pair of words of 32768.

name: pass_record_words_to_helper
description: Selects four 16-bit values from one of two record blocks depending on a flag byte, calling a helper first when the flag is set. It then passes the four values to another helper.

name: copy_matrix_to_buffer
description: Calls helpers, then copies one word and eight words from a record block into a destination buffer. It writes zero to two 32-bit slots and the constants 512 and 176 into fixed positions.

name: transform_object_matrix
description: Decrements a countdown and refreshes a cached vector through a helper when it expires. It multiplies a 3x3 matrix by the cached vector to write three result words into a global structure, and writes a second set of three when a flag byte is set.

name: compute_normalized_offset_entry
description: Subtracts stored position values from a 96-bit input and normalizes the three differences by shift counts until they fit in a 14-bit range. It stores them in a buffer with four 32-bit values taken from a table selected by a 3-bit field.

name: find_linked_entry_and_normalize
description: Walks entries until one has a flag bit set, then subtracts stored positions from a 96-bit input and normalizes the differences to a 14-bit range. It stores them with four table values selected by a 3-bit field.

name: store_values_load_table_entry
description: Normalizes a 64-bit input to a 14-bit range by shifts, stores three word values in a buffer and loads four 32-bit values from a table selected by a 3-bit field of a record byte.

name: process_flagged_table_entries
description: Sets bit two of a status byte, then scans a table backward for entries with bit eight set. For each match it calls helpers, clears flag bits, sets timer fields to 200 or 192, and marks matching entries with a pair of words of 32768.

name: process_flagged_entries_from_registers
description: Scans a flagged table backward for entries with bit eight set and calls helpers for each one. It clears two flag bits, resets timer fields to 200 and 192 when the timer flag was set, and marks matching entries with a pair of words of 32768.

name: mark_flagged_entries_and_scan
description: Writes a pair of words of 32768 into an entry, then scans a table backward for entries with bit eight set. Matching entries call helpers and adjust timer and flag fields before the scan continues.

name: scan_flagged_entries_with_counter
description: Scans a table backward for entries with bit eight set. For each one it either calls a helper and stores a word in the record when a counter byte is zero, or decrements that counter.

name: process_object_flags
description: Stores a word in a record field, then scans a table backward for entries with bit eight set. Each match calls a helper, and the scan restarts when a counter byte is zero or otherwise decrements that counter.

name: advance_object_position_by_velocity
description: Selects a table entry for the object, optionally negating its matrix rows by a flag, and forms two dot products shifted right by twelve bits. The results are added to the object's 96-bit position, and a timer field is set to 190.

name: advance_position_flagged_variant
description: Like its neighbour, it selects table values and matrix rows depending on a flag bit, then adds scaled dot products into the object's 96-bit position. It sets the timer field to 190.

name: advance_position_from_matrix
description: Computes dot products of a table vector with the object's matrix rows, adds them scaled by twelve bits into the 96-bit position, and sets the timer field to 190.

name: clear_object_counter_byte
description: Clears a counter byte at offset 97 in the record.

name: reset_and_scan_nonzero_entries
description: Clears a 16-bit record field, then scans a table backward for nonzero entries whose bit of value 32 is clear. Each match calls two helpers.

name: iterate_and_call_handler
description: Scans a table backward for nonzero entries whose bit of value 32 is clear. For each one it calls a helper and then a function through a pointer held in a register.

name: check_bounds_and_call
description: Scans a table backward for entries with bit eight set. For entries whose bit of value 32 is clear, it checks two record coordinates against fixed bounds and calls a function pointer only when both are within range.

name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Scans a table backward for entries with bit value one set. For each one it calls a helper, then either restores a counter from a stored value and calls a handler selected by a record byte, or decrements the counter.

name: process_bit_two_flag
description: Clears the bit of value two in a status byte, then scans a table backward for entries with that bit set. For each match it calls a helper and, when a record byte is non-zero, calls a handler selected by that byte.

name: write_byte_to_indirect
description: Writes the input byte to an address formed from a stored pointer plus a record byte offset.

name: claim_slot_and_copy_record
description: Finds a table slot by scanning backward for an entry whose bit of value 32 is set, stores a flag byte there and copies a record of about 71 words from the source pointer into it. When a further value is non-zero it stamps timing fields and computes shifted fixed-point values from the record.

name: claim_low_slot_copy_record
description: Scans backward for an entry whose bit of value 32 is clear, and when the index is above nineteen it stores a flag byte there. It copies the source record into that slot and stamps timing fields with fixed-point values when a further value is non-zero.

name: copy_record_into_indexed_slot
description: Stores a flag byte in an indexed table slot and copies a source record of about 71 words into it. When a further value is non-zero it stamps timing fields and computes shifted fixed-point values from the record.

name: copy_record_and_init_slot
description: Copies a record of about 71 words from the source to the destination pointer when they differ. For a non-zero index it stamps timing fields, computes fixed-point values from a table entry and sets a status byte to 255.

name: claim_free_slot_copy_record
description: Looks for a free table slot with an index above nineteen, falling back to an entry whose bit of value 32 is set. It copies the source record into the chosen slot with a flag byte, stamps timing fields and fixed-point values when a further value is non-zero, and otherwise returns the input value.

name: claim_slot_or_return_input
description: Looks for a free table slot, falling back to an entry whose bit of value 32 is set, and copies the source record into the slot with a flag byte. It stamps timing fields and fixed-point values when a further value is non-zero, and otherwise returns the input value unchanged.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work.
